pins.name: D4
pins.label: GPIO4 (Led Neopixel)
pins.notes: PIN_NEOPIXEL — onboard single status NeoPixel (WS2812), output-only data line. Confirmed via Adafruit's own learn.adafruit.com pinouts guide ("the status NeoPixel LED. It is on GPIO4") and CircuitPython's pins.c (NEOPIXEL -> pin_GPIO4).

pins.name: D7
pins.label: GPIO7 (Button)
pins.notes: PIN_BUTTON / BOOT — onboard bootloader-select pushbutton, also usable as a general input when application code is running (this board's own pins_arduino.h comment: "'Boot0' button also on GPIO #7"). Confirmed via CircuitPython's pins.c (both BUTTON and BOOT -> pin_GPIO7). Active-low with the RP2040's internal pull-up enabled — inferred from the identical GPIO7 BOOT wiring on the sibling adafruit_feather_scorpio board (same Adafruit Feather RP2040 reference design, same source pinout PDF, identical pins_arduino.h comment text), confirmed there via Zephyr's adafruit_feather_scorpio_rp2040.dts gpio_keys node (GPIO_ACTIVE_LOW | GPIO_PULL_UP). Full digital_input/digital_output/pwm_output capability retained (ordinary GPIO wired to a switch to GND, not a dedicated/capacitive-only pin), matching this repo's vccgnd_yd_rp2040 PIN_USRKEY and adafruit_feather_scorpio precedents.

pins.name: D13
pins.label: GPIO13 (Led active high)
pins.notes: PIN_LED — onboard status LED, active-high. Confirmed via Zephyr's adafruit_feather_rp2040.dts leds node for the base Feather RP2040 reference design this board shares (gpios = <&gpio0 13 GPIO_ACTIVE_HIGH>), consistent with Adafruit's own pinouts guide description of the LED. digital_input dropped to match this repo's established led_high precedent for dedicated onboard LED pins (rpipico, adafruit_feather_scorpio, wiznet_5500_evb_pico); pwm_output kept since arduino-pico's analogWrite() works on any RP2040 GPIO, enabling brightness dimming. This GPIO was also the vendor's default (unused) PIN_SPI0_SS alias, which would have contaminated this confirmed LED tag with a spurious spi_ss capability - fixed 2026-07-13 by removing that alias from pins_arduino.h (no onboard SPI device consumes it), matching the identical fix already applied to the sibling adafruit_feather_scorpio board.

pins.name: GPIO16
pins.label: GPIO16
pins.notes:
PIN_CKN — DVI/HDMI connector TMDS clock- differential line, PIO-driven bit-banged output dedicated to the onboard DVI connector (PicoDVI library). Confirmed via Adafruit's overview page ("8 unused pins for DVI output that can be used with the PicoDVI library") and CircuitPython's pins.c (CKN -> pin_GPIO16). Not general-purpose; this board's own pins_arduino.h already omits a D16 alias for this reason.
